name: @dsh-app/plugin-brand
description: DSH APP brand host plugin: trust-fenced host routes under /plugins/@dsh-app/plugin-brand/api that forward native desktop actions (open-in-folder, notify, save-text-as, pick-directory, open-logs) to the shell's loopback desktop bridge, expose the shell's log tail for the diagnostics page, and report bridge availability. The brand settings namespace and the app-info service are still TODOs (see src/index.ts).
